# ============================================================
# Ultimate Windows Setup - konfiguracja systemu i zasilania
# Windows 10 / Windows 11
# ============================================================
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$LogDirectory = 'C:\UltimateSetup\Logs' $LogFile = Join-Path $LogDirectory 'SystemSetup.log'
New-Item -Path $LogDirectory -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
try { Start-Transcript -Path $LogFile -Append -Force } catch { Write-Warning "Nie udalo sie uruchomic transkrypcji: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
Write-Host '============================================================' Write-Host 'ULTIMATE SETUP - konfiguracja systemu' Write-Host '============================================================'
function Invoke-PowerCfg { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string[]] $Arguments )
$commandText = 'powercfg.exe ' + ($Arguments -join ' ') Write-Host "[POWERCFG] $commandText"
$output = & powercfg.exe @Arguments 2>&1
if ($output) { $output | ForEach-Object { Write-Host " $_" } }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Warning "Polecenie zakonczylo sie kodem $LASTEXITCODE." return $false }
return $true
}
function Set-PowerValue { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Scheme,
[Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidateSet('AC', 'DC')] [string] $PowerSource,
[Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $SubGroup,
[Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Setting,
[Parameter(Mandatory)] [int] $Value )
$operation = if ($PowerSource -eq 'AC') { '/setacvalueindex' } else { '/setdcvalueindex' }
Invoke-PowerCfg -Arguments @( $operation, $Scheme, $SubGroup, $Setting, [string] $Value ) | Out-Null
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Wykrycie aktywnego planu i wszystkich dostepnych planow
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$activeSchemeOutput = (& powercfg.exe /getactivescheme 2>&1) -join ' ' $activeSchemeMatch = [regex]::Match( $activeSchemeOutput, '(?i)\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b' )
if (-not $activeSchemeMatch.Success) { throw 'Nie udalo sie ustalic aktywnego planu zasilania.' }
$activeScheme = $activeSchemeMatch.Value Write-Host "[INFO] Aktywny plan zasilania: $activeScheme"
$schemeListOutput = (& powercfg.exe /list 2>&1) -join "`n"
$schemeGuids = [regex]::Matches( $schemeListOutput, '(?i)\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b' ) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique
if (-not $schemeGuids) { $schemeGuids = @($activeScheme) }
Write-Host "[INFO] Liczba wykrytych planow: $($schemeGuids.Count)"
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Wykrycie baterii
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$batteries = @( Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Battery -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue )
$hasBattery = $batteries.Count -gt 0
if ($hasBattery) { Write-Host "[INFO] Wykryto baterie: $($batteries.Count)" Write-Host '[INFO] Profil mobilny: laptop / handheld / ROG Ally.'
# Hibernacja potrzebna do zabezpieczenia sesji przy 7% baterii. Invoke-PowerCfg -Arguments @('/hibernate', 'on') | Out-Null
} else { Write-Host '[INFO] Nie wykryto baterii.' Write-Host '[INFO] Profil stacjonarny: hibernacja zostanie wylaczona.'
Invoke-PowerCfg -Arguments @('/hibernate', 'off') | Out-Null
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Identyfikatory ustawien zasilania
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$SUB_PROCESSOR = '54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00' $CPU_MIN = '893dee8e-2bef-41e0-89c6-b55d0929964c' $CPU_MAX = 'bc5038f7-23e0-4960-96da-33abaf5935ec' $CPU_BOOST = 'be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7'
$SUB_USB = '2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3' $USB_SUSPEND = '48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226'
$SUB_DISPLAY = '7516b95f-f776-4464-8c53-06167f40cc99' $DISPLAY_TIMEOUT = '3c0bc021-c8a8-4e07-a973-6b14cbcb2b7e'
$SUB_SLEEP = '238c9fa8-0aad-41ed-83f4-97be242c8f20' $SLEEP_TIMEOUT = '29f6c1db-86da-48c5-9fdb-f2b67b1f44da'
$SUB_BATTERY = 'e73a048d-bf27-4f12-9731-8b2076e8891f' $BAT_LOW_LEVEL = '8183ba9a-e910-48da-8769-14ae6dc1170a' $BAT_LOW_WARNING = 'bcded951-187b-4d05-bccc-f7e51960c258' $BAT_LOW_ACTION = 'd8742dcb-3e6a-4b3c-b3fe-374623cdcf06' $BAT_RESERVE = 'f3c5027d-cd16-4930-aa6b-90db844a8f00' $BAT_CRIT_LEVEL = '9a66d8d7-4ff7-4ef9-b5a2-5a326ca2a469' $BAT_CRIT_ACTION = '637ea02f-bbcb-4015-8e2c-a1c7b9c0b546'
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Konfiguracja wszystkich istniejacych planow zasilania
# ------------------------------------------------------------
foreach ($scheme in $schemeGuids) { Write-Host '------------------------------------------------------------' Write-Host "[INFO] Konfiguracja planu: $scheme"
# Procesor: bez ograniczania maksymalnej wydajnosci. Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_MIN 5 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_MIN 5 Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_MAX 100 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_MAX 100
# Tryb 2 = agresywne korzystanie z Turbo/Boost, gdy sprzet pozwala. Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_BOOST 2 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_PROCESSOR $CPU_BOOST 2
# Selektywne wstrzymywanie USB: 0 = wylaczone. Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_USB $USB_SUSPEND 0 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_USB $USB_SUSPEND 0
# Ekran: # AC: nigdy # DC: 10 minut Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_DISPLAY $DISPLAY_TIMEOUT 0 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_DISPLAY $DISPLAY_TIMEOUT 600
# Uspienie: # AC: nigdy # DC: po 30 minutach Set-PowerValue $scheme AC $SUB_SLEEP $SLEEP_TIMEOUT 0 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_SLEEP $SLEEP_TIMEOUT 1800
if ($hasBattery) { # Niski poziom: 15%, pokaz ostrzezenie, bez automatycznej akcji. Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_LOW_LEVEL 15 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_LOW_WARNING 1 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_LOW_ACTION 0
# Poziom rezerwowy: 10%. Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_RESERVE 10
# Poziom krytyczny: 7%. # Akcja 2 = hibernacja. Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_CRIT_LEVEL 7 Set-PowerValue $scheme DC $SUB_BATTERY $BAT_CRIT_ACTION 2 }
}
# Ponowne aktywowanie planu odswieza zastosowane ustawienia.
Invoke-PowerCfg -Arguments @('/setactive', $activeScheme) | Out-Null
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Windows Search
# ------------------------------------------------------------
try { Set-Service -Name 'WSearch' -StartupType Manual -ErrorAction Stop Write-Host '[OK] Windows Search ustawiono na uruchamianie reczne.' } catch { Write-Warning "Nie udalo sie ustawic WSearch: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Ikona Windows Security / Defender
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$defenderTrayPolicy = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Systray'
try { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $defenderTrayPolicy -Name 'HideSystray' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host '[OK] Usunieto polityke ukrywajaca ikone Windows Security.'
} catch { Write-Warning "Nie udalo sie poprawic ikony Defendera: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Windows Update - bez samoczynnego restartu zalogowanej sesji
# ------------------------------------------------------------
$windowsUpdateAu = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU'
try { New-Item -Path $windowsUpdateAu -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
# Automatyczne pobieranie i instalowanie aktualizacji. New-ItemProperty ` -Path $windowsUpdateAu ` -Name 'AUOptions' ` -PropertyType DWord ` -Value 4 ` -Force | Out-Null
# Nie restartuj automatycznie, gdy uzytkownik jest zalogowany. New-ItemProperty ` -Path $windowsUpdateAu ` -Name 'NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers' ` -PropertyType DWord ` -Value 1 ` -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host '[OK] Windows Update pozostaje wlaczony.' Write-Host '[OK] Zablokowano automatyczny restart zalogowanej sesji.'
} catch { Write-Warning "Nie udalo sie ustawic Windows Update: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Odinstalowanie Microsoft Edge
# Microsoft Edge WebView2 pozostaje zainstalowany
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '[INFO] Sprawdzanie Microsoft Edge...'
$EdgeRoots = @( 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application', 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft\Edge\Application' )
$EdgeInstaller = @( foreach ($Root in $EdgeRoots) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Root) { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d+(\.\d+)+$' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'Installer\setup.exe')) } | Sort-Object { [version]$_.Name } -Descending | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'Installer\setup.exe' } } } ) | Select-Object -First 1
if ($EdgeInstaller) { Write-Host "[INFO] Znaleziono instalator Edge: $EdgeInstaller"
try { $Process = Start-Process ` -FilePath $EdgeInstaller ` -ArgumentList @( '--uninstall', '--system-level', '--verbose-logging', '--force-uninstall' ) ` -Wait ` -PassThru ` -ErrorAction Stop
if ($Process.ExitCode -eq 0) { Write-Host '[OK] Microsoft Edge zostal odinstalowany.' } else { Write-Warning "Deinstalator Edge zakonczyl sie kodem: $($Process.ExitCode)" } } catch { Write-Warning "Nie udalo sie odinstalowac Edge: $($_.Exception.Message)" } } else { Write-Host '[INFO] Microsoft Edge nie jest zainstalowany albo nie znaleziono deinstalatora.' } # ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Podsumowanie
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '============================================================' Write-Host 'PODSUMOWANIE' Write-Host "Bateria wykryta: $hasBattery" Write-Host 'CPU AC/DC: minimum 5%, maksimum 100%' Write-Host 'Turbo/Boost AC/DC: agresywne' Write-Host 'USB selective suspend AC/DC: wylaczone' Write-Host 'Ekran AC: nigdy' Write-Host 'Ekran DC: 10 minut' Write-Host 'Uspienie AC: nigdy' Write-Host 'Uspienie DC: 30 minut' Write-Host 'WSearch: Manual' Write-Host 'Windows Update: wlaczony, bez restartu zalogowanej sesji'
if ($hasBattery) { Write-Host 'Bateria niska: 15%' Write-Host 'Bateria rezerwowa: 10%' Write-Host 'Bateria krytyczna: 7%' Write-Host 'Akcja krytyczna: hibernacja' } else { Write-Host 'Hibernacja: wylaczona' }
Write-Host "Log: $LogFile" Write-Host '============================================================'
try { Stop-Transcript } catch { # Brak dzialania, gdy transkrypcja nie zostala uruchomiona. }
